en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated it to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, with the same meaning.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated it to me. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). H; and Sa'id ibn Mansur, Khalaf ibn Hisham, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. They said: Hammad ibn Zayd informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. She said: It is as though I can see myself twisting the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). H; and Sa'id ibn Mansur, Khalaf ibn Hisham, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. They said: Hammad ibn Zayd berichtete uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. Sie sagte: It is as though I can see myself twisting the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, who said: I heard Aisha say: I used these two hands of mine to twist the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), then he did not abstain from anything and did not leave it.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, who said: I heard Aisha say: I used these two hands of mine to twist the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), then he did not abstain from anything and did not leave it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us. Aflah narrated to us, from al-Qasim, from Aisha. She said: I twisted the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with these two hands of mine. Then he marked them and garlanded them, sent them toward the House, and remained in Madinah. Nothing that had been lawful for him became forbidden to him.
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab überlieferte uns. Aflah überlieferte uns, from al-Qasim, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I twisted the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) with these two hands of mine. Then he marked them and garlanded them, sent them toward the Haus, and remained in Medina. Nothing that had been erlaubt for him became forbidden to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di and Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi narrated to us. Ibn Hujr said: Ismail ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from Ayyub, from al-Qasim and Abu Qilabah, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send sacrificial animals. I would twist their garlands with these two hands of mine, then he would not abstain from anything from which a person who is lawful does not abstain.
de: Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di and Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi überlieferte uns. Ibn Hujr said: Ismail ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns, from Ayyub, from al-Qasim and Abu Qilabah, from Aisha. Sie sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send Opfertiere. I would twist their garlands with these two hands of mine, then he would not abstain from anything from which a person who is erlaubt does not abstain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Husayn ibn al-Hasan narrated to us. Ibn Awn narrated to us, from al-Qasim, from the Mother of the Believers. She said: I twisted those garlands from wool that we had. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) remained among us in a state of lawfulness, doing what a lawful man does with his family.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Husayn ibn al-Hasan überlieferte uns. Ibn Awn überlieferte uns, from al-Qasim, from the Mother of the Believers. Sie sagte: I twisted those garlands from wool that we had. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) remained among us in a state of erlaubtness, doing what a erlaubt man does with his family. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: I saw myself twisting the garlands for the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) from sheep. He would send them, then remain among us in a state of lawfulness.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. Jarir überlieferte uns, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I saw myself twisting the garlands for the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) from Schafe. He would send them, then remain among us in a state of erlaubtness. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Yahya said: Abu Muawiyah informed us, and the other two said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: Sometimes I twisted the garlands for the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He would garland his sacrificial animal, send it away, and remain without avoiding anything that a person in ihram avoids.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Yahya said: Abu Muawiyah berichtete uns, and the other two said: Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. Sie sagte: Sometimes I twisted the garlands for the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). He would garland his Opfertier, send it away, and remain without avoiding anything that a person in ihram avoids. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Yahya said: Abu Muawiyah informed us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: Once the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent sheep as an offering to the House and garlanded them.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Yahya said: Abu Muawiyah berichtete uns, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. Sie sagte: Once der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) sent Schafe as an Opfergabe to the Haus and garlanded them. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to us. Abd al-Samad narrated to us. My father narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Juhadah narrated to me, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: We garlanded the sheep and sent them away while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was lawful; nothing from it was forbidden to him.
de: Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Abd al-Samad überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Juhadah überlieferte mir, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. Sie sagte: We garlanded the Schafe and sent them away while der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was erlaubt; nothing from it was forbidden to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, who informed him that Ibn Ziyad wrote to Aisha that Ibn Abbas had said: Whoever sends a sacrificial animal, what is forbidden to the pilgrim is forbidden to him until the sacrifice is slaughtered. I have sent my sacrifice, so write to me with your ruling. Amrah said that Aisha said: It is not as Ibn Abbas said. I twisted the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with my own hands, then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) garlanded them with his own hand and sent them with Abu. Nothing that Allah had made lawful for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became forbidden to him until the sacrifice was slaughtered.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, who informed him that Ibn Ziyad wrote to Aisha that Ibn Abbas had said: Whoever sends a Opfertier, what is forbidden to the Pilger is forbidden to him until the Opfer is slaughtered. I have sent my Opfer, so write to me with your ruling. Amrah said that Aisha said: It is not as Ibn Abbas said. I twisted the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) with my own hands, then der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) garlanded them with his own hand and sent them with Abu. Nothing that Allah had made erlaubt for der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) became forbidden to him until the Opfer was slaughtered. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us. Hushaym narrated to us. Ismail ibn Abi Khalid informed us, from al-Shabi, from Masruq, who said: I heard Aisha, behind the curtain, clapping and saying: I twisted the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with my own hands, then he sent them away. He did not abstain from anything from which a person in ihram abstains until his sacrifice was slaughtered.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Hushaym überlieferte uns. Ismail ibn Abi Khalid berichtete uns, from al-Shabi, from Masruq, who said: I heard Aisha, behind the curtain, clapping and saying: I twisted the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) with my own hands, then he sent them away. He did not abstain from anything from which a person in ihram abstains until his Opfer was slaughtered. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, from Dawud. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Zakariyya narrated to us. Both of them narrated from al-Shabi, from Masruq, from Aisha, with the same meaning from the Prophet (peace be upon him).
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Wahhab überlieferte uns, from Dawud. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Zakariyya überlieferte uns. Both of them narrated from al-Shabi, from Masruq, from Aisha, with the same meaning from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw a man leading a sacrificial camel and said: Ride it. The man said: Messenger of Allah, it is a sacrificial camel. He said: Ride it, woe to you, a second or a third time.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) saw a man leading a Opferkamel and said: Ride it. The man said: Messenger of Allah, it is a Opferkamel. Er sagte: Ride it, woe to you, a second or a third time. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Al-Mughirah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Hizami informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, with this chain. It says: While a man was leading a garlanded sacrificial camel.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Al-Mughirah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Hizami berichtete uns, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, with this chain. It says: While a man was leading a garlanded Opferkamel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar narrated to us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurayra narrated to us, from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He mentioned hadiths, including this: While a man was leading a garlanded sacrificial camel, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to him: Woe to you, ride it. He said: It is a sacrificial camel, Messenger of Allah. He said: Woe to you, ride it; woe to you, ride it.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar überlieferte uns, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurayra überlieferte uns, from Muhammad, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). He mentioned hadiths, including this: While a man was leading a garlanded Opferkamel, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said to him: Woe to you, ride it. Er sagte: It is a Opferkamel, Messenger of Allah. Er sagte: Woe to you, ride it; woe to you, ride it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Amr al-Naqid and Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to me. They said: Hushaym narrated to us. Humayd informed us, from Thabit, from Anas. I think I heard it from Anas. H; and Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and this is his wording. Hushaym informed us, from Humayd, from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) passed by a man leading a sacrificial camel and said: Ride it. The man said: It is a sacrificial camel. He said: Ride it, two or three times.
de: Amr al-Naqid and Surayj ibn Yunus überlieferte mir. They said: Hushaym überlieferte uns. Humayd berichtete uns, from Thabit, from Anas. I think I heard it from Anas. H; and Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns, and this is his wording. Hushaym berichtete uns, from Humayd, from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) passed by a man leading a Opferkamel and said: Ride it. The man said: It is a Opferkamel. Er sagte: Ride it, two or three times. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Waki narrated to us, from Misar, from Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas, from Anas. He said: I heard him say: A sacrificial camel or an offering was led past the Prophet (peace be upon him), and he said: Ride it. The man said: It is a sacrificial camel or an offering. He said: Even so.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Waki überlieferte uns, from Misar, from Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas, from Anas. Er sagte: I heard him say: A Opferkamel or an Opfergabe was led past der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: Ride it. The man said: It is a Opferkamel or an Opfergabe. Er sagte: Even so. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Ibn Bishr narrated to us, from Misar. Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas narrated to me. He said: I heard Anas say: A sacrificial camel was led past the Prophet (peace be upon him). He mentioned the same as this.
de: Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Ibn Bishr überlieferte uns, from Misar. Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas überlieferte mir. Er sagte: I heard Anas say: A Opferkamel was led past der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). He mentioned the same as this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Abu al-Zubayr informed me. He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah being asked about riding a sacrificial animal. He said: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) say: Ride it properly when you are forced to do so, until you find another mount.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete mir. Er sagte: I heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah being asked about riding a Opfertier. Er sagte: I heard der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Ride it properly when you are forced to do so, until you find another mount. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me. al-Hasan ibn Ayan narrated to us. Maqil narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, who said: I asked Jabir about riding a sacrificial animal. He said: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) say: Ride it properly until you find another mount.
de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. al-Hasan ibn Ayan überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, who said: I asked Jabir about riding a Opfertier. Er sagte: I heard der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Ride it properly until you find another mount. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abd al-Warith ibn Sa'id informed us, from Abu al-Tayyah al-Dubai. Musa ibn Salamah al-Hudhali narrated to me. He said: I and Sinan ibn Salamah set out intending to perform Umrah. Sinan went with a sacrificial camel that he was leading, but it became exhausted on the road, and he did not know what to do if it could go no farther. He said: If I reach the town, I will seek a ruling about this. When morning came and we reached al-Batha, he said: Let us go to Ibn Abbas and speak with him. He told him about his camel. Ibn Abbas said: You have asked the one who knows. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent sixteen sacrificial camels with a man and put him in charge of them. He went, then returned and said: Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those among them that become unable to continue? He said: Slaughter it, dye its sandals in its blood, mark its side with them, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abd al-Warith ibn Sa'id berichtete uns, from Abu al-Tayyah al-Dubai. Musa ibn Salamah al-Hudhali überlieferte mir. Er sagte: I and Sinan ibn Salamah set out intending to perform Umra. Sinan went with a Opferkamel that he was leading, but it became exhausted on the road, and he did not know what to do if it could go no farther. Er sagte: If I reach the town, I will seek a ruling about this. When morning came and we reached al-Batha, he said: Let us go to Ibn Abbas and speak with him. He told him about his Kamel. Ibn Abbas said: You have asked the one who knows. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent sixteen Opferkamels with a man and put him in charge of them. He went, then returned and said: Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those among them that become unable to continue? Er sagte: Slaughter it, dye its sandals in its blood, mark its side with them, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Ali ibn Hujr narrated it to us. Yahya said: Ismail ibn Ulayyah informed us, and the other two said: He narrated to us, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Musa ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent eighteen sacrificial camels with a man. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Abd al-Warith, without mentioning the beginning of the hadith.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Ali ibn Hujr narrated it to us. Yahya said: Ismail ibn Ulayyah berichtete uns, and the other two said: He überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Musa ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) sent eighteen Opferkamels with a man. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Abd al-Warith, without mentioning the beginning of the hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i narrated to me. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Sinan ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that Dhuwayb, Abu Qabisah, told him that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send sacrificial camels with him and say: If one of them becomes ill and you fear it will die, slaughter it, dip its sandal in its blood, strike its side with it, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it.
de: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i überlieferte mir. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Qatadah, from Sinan ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that Dhuwayb, Abu Qabisah, told him that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to send Opferkamels with him and say: If one of them becomes ill and you fear it will die, slaughter it, dip its sandal in its blood, strike its side with it, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, who said: People used to leave in every direction, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one should depart until his final contact is with the House. Zuhayr said: They used to leave in every direction, and he did not say 'in'.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, who said: People used to leave in every direction, so der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: No one should depart until his final contact is with the Haus. Zuhayr said: They used to leave in every direction, and he did not say 'in'. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, and Sa'id's wording is used. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The people were commanded to make their last contact with the House, except that the menstruating woman was excused from this.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns, and Sa'id's wording is used. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The people were commanded to make their last contact with the Haus, except that the menstruating woman was excused from this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Al-Hasan ibn Muslim informed me, from Tawus. He said: I was with Ibn Abbas when Zayd ibn Thabit said: You give the ruling that the menstruating woman may depart before her last contact is with the House. Ibn Abbas said to him: If not, ask so-and-so, the Ansari woman, whether the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded her to do that. Zayd ibn Thabit returned to Ibn Abbas laughing and saying: I see that you were truthful.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Al-Hasan ibn Muslim berichtete mir, from Tawus. Er sagte: I was with Ibn Abbas when Zayd ibn Thabit said: You give the ruling that the menstruating woman may depart before her last contact is with the Haus. Ibn Abbas said to him: If not, ask so-and-so, the Ansari woman, whether der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) commanded her to do that. Zayd ibn Thabit returned to Ibn Abbas laughing and saying: I see that you were truthful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah al-Hajabi entered the Ka'bah. He closed it upon them, and they stayed inside. Ibn Umar said: When Bilal came out, I asked him what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had done. He said: He placed two pillars to his left, one pillar to his right, and three pillars behind him. At that time the House had six pillars. Then he prayed.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah al-Hajabi entered the Ka'bah. He closed it upon them, and they stayed inside. Ibn Umar said: When Bilal came out, I asked him what der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had done. Er sagte: He placed two pillars to his left, one pillar to his right, and three pillars behind him. At that time the Haus had six pillars. Then he betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari all narrated from Hammad ibn Zayd. Abu Kamil said: Hammad narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: On the day of the conquest, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) arrived and stopped in the courtyard of the Ka'bah. He sent for Uthman ibn Talhah, who brought the key and opened the door. The Prophet (peace be upon him), Bilal, Usamah ibn Zayd, and Uthman ibn Talhah entered, and he ordered that the door be closed. They remained inside for a while, then the door was opened. Abd Allah said: I hurried ahead of the people and met the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) as he came out, with Bilal following him. I asked Bilal whether the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had prayed inside. He said: Yes. I asked: Where? He said: Between the two pillars facing him. I forgot to ask him how many units he prayed.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: In the year of the conquest, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came riding a she-camel belonging to Usamah ibn Zayd and made it kneel in the courtyard of the Ka'bah. He called Uthman ibn Talhah and said: Bring me the key. Uthman went to his mother, but she refused to give it to him. He said: By Allah, you will give it to me, or this sword will come out from my body. She gave it to him, and he brought it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who opened the door. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Hammad ibn Zayd.
